matrix: sparse CSR; sampled values non-integer, consistent with transformed expression; normalization and log1p provenance not independently established
guide_batch: not provided as standalone fields; barcode suffix is not assumed to be batch
hvg: within each training split, rank variance/mean after log1p and mean-bin z-score; computed on input expression, not Scanpy Seurat HVG
upstream_leakage: GEARS distribution already selected 5000 genes upstream; upstream HVG selection may use all cells. This prevents a strictly leakage-free benchmark.
